subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the shear wall between Structural General Notes

messages.text: The shear wall reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with additional #5 ties noted in Foundation Plan S-101. We would like this resolved ahead of the next concrete pour. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible. This sits right on the edge, timeline-wise; hard to say for certain how quickly this really needs to move.

Proceed with additional #5 ties per Foundation Plan S-101; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- additional #5 ties -- apply at every shear wall on this level, not just the one called out in Structural General Notes S-001?
